snippet.title: It Takes Weeks to Travel Between Planets | No End Game Devlog 6
snippet.description:
In this devlog I talk about the new navigation system, a full ship redesign, and some concepts I have for how I'm planning to design combat for No End.

No End: Explore a seamless endless universe with an uncountable number of galaxies, stars, planets, and moons. Make friends or enemies with unique alien civilizations. Research upgrades for your vessel with scientific phenomena and alien tech that you've acquired.
